main_text.p: plurima 10.li. fuppeditat, in quo Att. cõfi-liū Cic.exquirit:utrū in bello ciuili Pomp. an Cef.fequi:in Italia manere,aut alió fefe cõferre debeat.Nos 3.lib.8.imitabimur: in qua eadé de re cũ Att. cõfilia Cic.cõmuni-cat.Partes illi fúnt: Exordiũ,attētionis & beneuolētię habes captationé,rei magnę:Imitatio cõ- & ftudij cũ amico cõmunicandi municato- [illegible, ~5 letters] fi-gnificatione cõciliatur.Propofitio [illegible, ~4 letters] cõftās futurae deliberationis: nõ tñ nu-dè, verũ caufa addita finali inftituta: ut eò fcil.cõfiliũ facili dare Attic porsit.Cõfir-matio, q dubiã,ancipitè,difficilè reddëtia cõfultatione arguméta cõpleētiẗ.Conclu-fio [illegible, ~4 letters] cõfilij petitione cõtinens. Hifce nos veftigiis infiftētes cũ amico de inftitu endaftudiorũ & peregrinationis ratione noftra cõfilia cõmunicabimus,hoc modo.rii.
I. Magna & neceffaria de re confultatio eft mihi fufpicienda: quam hifce tibi nunc literis exponere volui:cum coram tecũ agĕdi facultas nõ concedatur.

II. Eft autē hæc omnis deliberatio:cum ftudiorum meorũ curfum ad finē prope hac in fchola perduxe-rim, ideoq; de alia iam fit nunc[?] cogitandū, quid mihi agendum exiftimes: manendum ne in Germania diu-tius,an vero in Galliam, aut Italiam eundum.
III. Et, quo facilius tuo mihi adeffe cõfilio queas, quid utramq; in partem occurrat,paucis indicabo.
IIII. Cum,& clarifimorum virorum exëpla in-

page.notes: The three marginal notes at the top right are only partly legible: "Imitatio cõ-", "municato-" and "rii." are read from fragments and may be wrong. The Greek words are uncertain and marked illegible where I could not read them letter by letter. "nunc" in II is doubtful. The last line of the page is cut off by the lower edge of the text block, so the end of "exëpla in-" continues on the next page. No catchword or signature is visible. The book's edge and the dark background are not transcribed.
